Buying a big expensive setup isn't going to help you avoid burning wicks, learning how to setup and properly use your vaporizer will. You can get an incredibly satisfying vape with big juicy clouds for under 100$. Get a variable wattage battery mod and a decent tank and learn about ohms law and wicking. Those "huge puffs of smoke" are most likely coming from a drip vape. Plus the more expensive ones are just going to be harsher because they are more powerful.
